::: {#bio}

Hello! 
I am Martin Tran. I am an undergraduate student learning about Computer Science, Data Science, and Dance at [Lawrence University](https://www.lawrence.edu/), [Appleton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Appleton,_Wisconsin), Wisconsin. 

I am a personal enjoyer of programming, data analytics, and movement. I like tackling life with a holistic view and trying out new things.

Outside the academic world, I like running, playing games, and having delicious foods. I also enjoy photography and learning other cultural identities.
